features.name: Adaptive multimodal cues
features.description: Configured preferences and experimentally measured responses guide visual, auditory and tactile cue selection. Local S3 cueing remains available without the Pi.

features.name: Foot + cane sensor fusion
features.description: Ankle IMU → C3 → wireless BLE → S3; cane IMU joins the stream. Timestamp alignment and packet-loss handling require firmware validation.

features.name: Fall detection & caregiver alerts
features.description: Suspected fall → local alarm → confirmation / cancel interval → Wi-Fi notification request. Offline: retain local alarm and queue event. Delivery is not guaranteed.

features.name: Gait analytics
features.description: Step timing, variability and event history are intended analytics. The animation illustrates data flow; no live patient data or analytics engine is connected.

features.name: Experimental freezing prediction
features.description: Movement features → experimental model inference → configured cue. No trained model or clinical validation is supplied; prediction performance is unestablished.

features.name: Context-aware assistance
features.description: Camera scene interpretation plus coarse ToF distance sensing informs experimental assistance. FOV follows cane tilt; this is not validated safe navigation.
